Phone/Gadget had the strongest channel verification rate of all 5 categories: 7/10 directly page-fetched (TechCabal, Techpoint Africa, Carlcare, NorthridgeFix, iPad Rehab, Louis Rossmann, The Signal Path), plus 3 multi-source search-confirmed (JerryRigEverything, iFixit, TronicsFix).
